newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Apple rises on earnings.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Apple rises on earnings.

text.p: Shares of Apple Computer Inc rose 2-1/2 to 28-1/4 after hours Wednesday, traders said.
After the market closed, Apple reported earnings for the fourth quarter ended September 27 of $0.20 a share, compared to earnings of $0.48 a share the previous third quarter.
Apple had posted losses in its prior three quarters of this fiscal year.
The New York Stock Excahnge said that Raychem Corp and General Instrument Corp were unavailable for after hours trade for news.
The NYSE said that session one volume was 4,800 shares, compared to 98,300 shares Tuesday. There was no session two activity Wednesday or Tuesday.
The American Stock Exchange said there was no after-hours activity.
